about: One-frame order of esv::status::DispelSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x2C89970) to destroy a status that a dispel roll beat; sibling of esv::status::DispelRollCheckOneFrameComponent (Status.h: two bytes + two EntityHandles at +8/+0x10).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x2C89D90 writes 0xFFC0000000000000; bg3.exe+0x2C89970 copies the first 8 bytes (+0) of a dispel record when the record's byte at +0x10 is not below the rolled value.
Creator writes 0xFFC0000000000000; bg3.exe+0x2C89970 copies the second 8 bytes (+8) of the same dispel record.
